Landing.heroSubheadline: Eisenhower Planner helps you organize personal and work tasks by urgency and importance, so you always know what to do now, schedule, delegate, or eliminate.
Landing.problemTitle: Task lists show what needs to be done.
Landing.problemSubtitle: But not what truly matters first.
Landing.problemDescription: Most productivity tools give you endless lists without helping you decide what deserves your attention right now. You end up overwhelmed, unsure where to start.
Landing.solutionDescription: Divide your tasks into four clear quadrants based on urgency and importance. Instantly see what needs immediate action, what to plan for later, what to delegate, and what to let go.
Landing.step1Description: Capture everything on your mind in one place.
Landing.step2Description: Quickly classify each task with simple toggles.
Landing.step3Description: Tasks sort into four quadrants instantly.
Landing.step4Description: Reorder tasks as your day evolves.
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to stay focused
Landing.feature1Description: See all your priorities at a glance in a clean, familiar layout.
Landing.feature2Description: Separate life and work tasks with simple filtering.
Landing.feature3Description: Reorganize priorities as work changes throughout the day.
Landing.feature4Description: Your workspace is protected with modern authentication.
Landing.feature5Description: Track progress without losing sight of what is still active.
Landing.whoProfessionalsDesc: Manage meetings, deadlines, and strategic projects.
Landing.whoFreelancersDesc: Balance multiple clients and personal goals.
Landing.whoBusyPeopleDesc: Organize work and life without the overwhelm.
Landing.betaDescription: Start using Eisenhower Planner today at no cost. Paid plans with advanced features are coming later.
Landing.finalCtaDescription: Create a workspace and make your next decision easier.

showcase.description: Prioritize what matters, decide with clarity, and keep your day focused.
